name: PICARD
one_liner: Constrained beam search that rejects invalid tokens at every decoding step using an incremental Haskell SQL parser and database schema type-checker.

loop.proposes: A sequence-to-sequence language model (T5) proposes top-k next tokens across active beam hypotheses.
loop.judged_by: An incremental monadic parser and relational schema checker verify lexical, syntactic, and column/table scoping validity on every partial prefix.
loop.steers: Invalid token continuations are masked to negative infinity before beam pruning, keeping only grammar- and schema-valid queries in the beam.

headline_result: Boosted T5-3B exact-match and execution accuracy on Spider and CoSQL benchmarks by 4-7 percentage points and eliminated 98% of syntax and schema errors.
caveat: Enforces grammatical and schema well-formedness, but cannot prevent a semantically plausible query that filters on the wrong column value.
beyond_harness_note: An incremental formal parser and relational type-checker gate every step of beam search, pruning invalid prefixes online.
algorithmic_authority: Incremental monadic SQL parser and relational schema type-checker

sources.title: PICARD: Parsing Incrementally for Constrained Auto-Regressive Decoding from Language Models (EMNLP 2021 / arXiv:2109.05093)

verification.notes: Checked against Scholak et al., EMNLP 2021.
